purpose: Counterfactual candle-path replay of profit protection without changing entries or production code.

replay_contract.source: 1h candle path covering each observed trade from entry until original close
replay_contract.protected_exit: after activation, exit when a later candle crosses the active protected-return price
replay_contract.same_candle_ambiguity: if a candle can both activate a new protection level and cross its protected exit and intrabar order is unknowable, use conservative ordering against the protection rule
replay_contract.original_exit: if no protected exit occurs first, preserve original observed exit
replay_contract.costs: preserve observed trading-cost assumptions; do not improve costs for the candidate

decision_rule.promotion_requires: material reduction in severe giveback losses without materially destroying winners; result remains research-only until fresh post-fix observation
